svg.title: Physical DC Shunt measured_j, Four-Vendor CubeCL GPU Shaders, and Fleet-Wide Six-Kernel Audit
svg.desc: Data-driven summary of Phase 29 empirical measurements: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor TI INA3221 VDD_CPU_SOC_MSS and INA238 VIN physical DC shunt measured_j reductions across Sub1Bit-LUT6, Expert-AirMoL, and Proposition 1 downward compilation; single-source Burn/CubeCL INT4 MoE and GatedDeltaNet GPU speedups across Apple Metal, AMD Radeon 8060S Vulkan, NVIDIA RTX 4050 Vulkan, and Intel Iris Xe Vulkan; and Linux bwrap-sandboxed 6-kernel Lean 4.36.0 verification across 1,391 theorems in four OpenIE repositories.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Claims LA-24, LA-25 & LA-19 | Strict OpenIE Anti-Laundering: measured_j (DC Shunt) != reported_j (RAPL/NVML/PPT/L3) != est_j
